title: A flexible CTGAN that can be customized by conditioning on user-specified variables(s)
summary: A modified fork of the official CTGAN source code that adds a user-specified conditioning parameter to the CTGAN, DataSampler and DataTransformer classes for research on controlling which discrete columns synthetic data is conditioned on. It directly vendors and modifies CTGAN's source tree, including its use of rdt transformers, into a new tool.
evidence: README: 'This repo modified the CTGAN official source code ... and made CTGAN conditional on any user-specified discrete columns'; ctgan/data_transformer.py:8 imports rdt.transformers
